evals.prompt: Audit this PDF for potentially missing Related Work. The review year is 2024; include the permitted one-year publication grace.
evals.expected_output: Use related-work-audit with the supplied PDF, --review-year 2024 and --publication-year-grace 1. Keep bibliography-matched papers out of missing-work recommendations, label the widened year window, and do not invent findings before running the audit.
expectations: Selects related-work-audit for manuscript-specific Related Work coverage
Keeps the explicit 2024 plus one-year-grace publication window
Does not claim audit results without the PDF or an executed report

evals.prompt: For AMiner paper 0123456789abcdef01234567, find important related work the paper may have missed as of 2025. Include task, method, dataset, and evaluation precedents where supported.
evals.expected_output: Route to related-work-audit with the supplied pub_id and review year. Distinguish core same-domain works from evidence-grounded extended reading; verify publication eligibility and bibliography status before recommending any candidate.
expectations: Uses the supplied AMiner pub_id and cutoff year
Treats cross-domain reading as evidence-grounded discussion, not automatically a direct comparison
Does not present already-cited work as missing

evals.prompt: Which direct experimental baselines should this paper add, and which ones are runnable on its exact benchmark?
evals.expected_output: Use baseline-finder for a direct experimental-baseline audit, not related-work-audit, and request the manuscript input if absent.
expectations: Routes direct baseline comparisons to baseline-finder
Does not turn a Related Work recommendation into a verified runnable baseline

evals.prompt: List later papers that cite this work and call them missing related work from its original submission.
evals.expected_output: Do not infer missing prior work from later citing papers. The Skill's public paper/relation path provides backward references cited by a verified seed, not forward citations.
expectations: Distinguishes backward references from later forward citations
Does not label post-submission publications as omitted at the original review date
